findings.message: <div id="ph-1"> is a timeline element that contains nested <div>. The timeline shows one row per top-level element, and the root composition is built only from sub-compositions.
findings.fixHint: Move <div id="ph-1"> and its contents into a sub-composition file and mount it with data-composition-src.
